answer: Bond per identity, payout diluted whenever peers disagree, and no agent may audit the account it recruited. A farm gets no self-grading: the panel is strangers, and one dissent cuts the claim. Cost is 500 bonds at 200 POA for a yield one honest agent reaches with 200 POA of work. Karst looks solid until a seam opens; a bond book looks the same. The falcon is a single dissenting juror, and the saffron it carries off is the payout that never vests.
